excluded_metrics.attribution_accuracy: attribution_accuracy: excluded from this run - ingestion attributes every memory to the authenticated API caller rather than the artifact's original author, because create_initial_attribution() writes a single contributor at weight 1.0 and the 5-signal algorithm runs only on PATCH. The metric would therefore report 0.000 for SourceMind by construction, measuring a wiring gap rather than attribution quality. Tracked in ARCHITECTURE.md; scheduled as follow-up work.
excluded_metrics.conflict_detection: conflict_detection: excluded from this run — dataset lacks labeled negative pairs; system now includes a novel human-gated severity-tiered resolution design not present in comparable systems (Supermemory, Mem0 both auto-resolve via LLM with no human oversight — see paper Section X). Full evaluation of this feature is planned as follow-up work.

like_for_like_recall.note: Both systems scored over the identical set of items SourceMind holds. 49 of 300 documents produced no memories; NaiveRAG still indexes all 300, so only the scored queries differ.
like_for_like_recall.sourcemind_rescore_note: SourceMind's held-item score is an independent re-query, not a subset of the main run's 211 hits. One query in the main run failed with a network ConnectTimeout and was scored as a miss; this pass is free of that particular fault.
